properties.evidence: One of two reflow2-side causes, measured at v0.74.0: artifact.rs:651 says "PROPAGATE deliberately does not traverse DOCUMENTS yet", so a file linked to a Decision is never reported stale when that Decision is revised, and a project must hand-check its decision log instead. The other cause is an absence (no served surface for a reader who does not run reflow2), which has no node to point at.
